show.description: “Mere boyfriend ki dangerous family” follows Vidya Sarabhai, the humble yet dignified mother of billionaire Madhav Sarabhai, who faces humiliation and brutality from corrupt resort staff during a cruise trip gone wrong. Mistaken for a poor woman, she endures cruelty until her true identity is revealed, leading to the downfall of her tormentors. The story unfolds into a gripping revenge and redemption drama where greed, arrogance, and kindness collide, ending with family reunion. Watch now.
